title: Design System: Sims 4 Mod Manager native

label.purpose: Authors, ownership, file counts and installed state.

nativeLayout.settingsSavePlacement: Save changes, Discard changes and Saved or Not saved section status stay above the Settings scroll region.
nativeLayout.shortLibraryFallback: Compact list below 220pt available content height; preserves saved view choice.

nativeStates.contextMenuSelection: Right-click selects the clicked card or list identity before opening the shared mod menu.
nativeStates.settingsSelection: Main destinations leave Settings; rail Settings or compact header Settings opens the full page.

nativeComponents.name: Photo card
nativeComponents.description: 140pt photo plus 98pt footer; direct On/Off switch shared with list rows and selected/focused outline.

nativeComponents.name: Search
nativeComponents.description: Shared 48pt shell, 10pt corners, 12pt horizontal and 6pt vertical margins, leading icon, 36pt text target, conditional 32x32pt clear control restoring focus, Ctrl+F hint on empty wide fields, full-shell accent focus outline and no input hover tooltip. Library filters live; Discover submits through Enter or its 88x36pt primary Search button.

nativeComponents.name: Main navigation
nativeComponents.description: Your mods, Discover and Updates in blue light or charcoal dark rail or compact top navigation.

nativeComponents.name: Add mods

nativeComponents.name: Mod details
nativeComponents.description: Centered popup at every width with file and source inspection.

extensions.documentationNote: Native egui components have no HTML/CSS runtime. Native records describe implemented widgets; no HTML/CSS detector or invented tonal ramp applies.

nativeSettings.save: Only Save changes validates, applies and persists the draft. Invalid hex colors, empty names and conflicting names prevent saving.
nativeSettings.settingsThemeSelection: Built-in and custom-theme choices, creation, editing and removal stay staged with a scoped production-widget preview until Save changes.
nativeSettings.headerThemeToggle: Hidden in Settings. Outside Settings, applies and persists only light/dark mode using saved custom colors; preserves drafts and never applies draft colors. Compact headers use an icon-only control.
nativeSettings.transfer: Backup export uses saved values, omits the key unless explicitly included, and omits customThemes and activeCustomTheme for older version-1 compatibility; separate theme JSON transfers both palettes.
nativeSettings.importPreservation: An empty or absent custom-theme collection preserves the local collection; an omitted API key preserves the local key.
nativeSettings.freshDefault: Light; existing saved themes and custom palettes retained.
nativeSettings.draftStatus: Saved or Not saved lists changed sections. Back and Escape preserve drafts; Discard changes restores saved preferences and reverses staged theme removal.
nativeSettings.paletteEditor: Independent Light colors and Dark colors editors with full #RRGGBB fields and pickers. Editor and scoped preview sit side by side at wide widths and stack at narrow widths.
nativeSettings.paletteReadability: Valid fills and accents stay as chosen. Text, metadata and links adjust against each actual painted background, targeting 4.5:1 contrast. Low contrast never replaces the whole palette.
nativeSettings.imports: Theme JSON previews and reviewed backup imports stage the current draft; Save changes is still required.

captureVerification.scope: Production Settings widgets with isolated synthetic themes, editor and section states, and opposing background/surface fills. No dedicated App updates capture.

nativeDiscovery.theme: Plumbob built-in light and charcoal dark roles, with saved custom palettes retained.
nativeDiscovery.navigation: Discover in the shared 240pt rail at widths of at least 900pt; compact top destinations below that width.

layout.shortWindow: Below 600 points of content height, expanded filters scroll with results; Clear filters remains reachable.
layout.projectScroll: Back to results remains above the scroll region.

filterGroups.labels: Above selectors; groups wrap together without horizontal overflow.

layout.filtersToggle: Filters button at every size, initially collapsed; shows active type/category/version count and current sort.
layout.filterExpansion: Unindented full-width controls with wrapping filter groups.
layout.inlineDisclosure: Concise verified-install and source-saving note beside Filters, wrapping naturally; asks for a game folder when none is selected.
layout.resultsToolbar: Result count and displayed range left; Previous/Next right.

states.cardHoverAndFocus: Existing selection stroke inside the 8-point card border when hovered or focused.
states.search: Search or Enter submits; content type, category, version and sort changes restart at index zero. Pagination retains every submitted dimension.
states.counts: Provider pagination supplies result count, range and Previous/Next availability.
states.setup: Connect to CurseForge with Open Settings and instructions to save a local API key.
states.error: Search unavailable with provider-specific guidance, Open Settings and Try again.
states.categoryError: Visible warning; available projects remain shown.
states.return: Back to results or Escape restores the current page; Ctrl+F returns to browser search.
states.browseBy: Provider root classes: Mods, Create a Sim, Build / Buy, Rooms / Lots, Sims / Households, Pets, Save Files, Worlds and Translations.
states.category: Searchable full parent paths scoped to the selected content type; changing type clears category.
states.gameVersion: Searchable numeric Sims 4 provider versions, newest first.
states.sortSemantics: Relevancy omits sortField for provider default ranking. Date released uses public API release-date sort 11; the website Creation Date sort is unavailable. Popularity uses 2, Latest update 3, Total Downloads 6 and A-Z 4 ascending.
states.clearFilters: Resets content type, category and game version while retaining search text and sort.
states.filterOptionLoading: Worker loads category and version options only when missing or after a failed attempt.

nativeDiscovery.scope: Current browser supports provider search and in-app inspection using the saved local key. Filtering saves no credentials or source metadata and does not download, update or attach mods. Future download and update actions require user initiation.

nativeUpdates.theme: Plumbob light and charcoal dark paired colors and native controls.
nativeUpdates.scope: Manual checks for managed mods with explicitly attached CurseForge projects and an API key saved in local Settings.
nativeUpdates.notices: In-app summary and Update available on checked cards and list rows; no automatic startup checks or operating-system notifications.
nativeUpdates.details: Check this mod distinguishes unknown installed version, changed local files, unavailable recorded release, incomplete history, operational failure, and comparison results.
nativeUpdates.comparison: Publication dates of stable public project releases after user-confirmed installed identity; newer releases may target other components or game versions.
nativeUpdates.installedIdentity: Record installed release selects a real provider release. Review installed release opens the existing confirmation popup; final Record installed release saves the project/file identity and managed-content digest in meta.json. Legacy source-suggestion fileId is not installed identity.
nativeUpdates.manualDownload: Open mod page opens the validated provider project URL. Users download there and replace files themselves, then record the new release and check again.
nativeUpdates.safety: Checks and page opening leave files and metadata unchanged. Confirmation writes metadata only. File changes make the recorded version unknown; changing or removing the source clears it.
nativeUpdates.invalidation: Root, catalog generation, saved-key changes, and local management operations invalidate results.

scope: Add mods button including pressed state
customThemeChrome.palette: Valid custom fills and accents apply per light/dark mode. Rail uses surface, selected destination uses selection fill, primary actions and enabled switches use accent. Text and knobs adjust against their painted fills.
customThemeChrome.fallback: Invalid hex colors prevent Settings saving. Low contrast adjusts text against each painted background without replacing the palette; choosing Built-in restores Plumbob after Save changes.
customThemeChrome.verification: Rendered light/dark regression failed before the fix and passes afterward, including switching back to built-in chrome. Fifteen native fixture captures preserve inputs.

nativeLibraryActions.toggle: Cards, list rows, details and context menus submit Action::Toggle { enabled } directly. Switch clicks open no details or review; failures appear as persistent in-app error notifications and in Activity.
nativeLibraryActions.safety: Core toggle operations retain locking, ownership and collision checks, and journaling.
nativeLibraryActions.newImports: Folder and ZIP imports enable in the selected game after storage. An enable conflict retains imported library content and unrelated game files, shows a warning and offers no retry-import. Browser-assisted imports retain their existing consent and automatic enabling.

nativeActivity.ownership: controls/activity.rs owns Activity display and notification lifecycle; existing filesystem, approval, browser import and retry backends are preserved.
nativeActivity.layout: Header Activity replaces catalog-status bottom panel. Redundant Local library and CurseForge browser shell labels and scan-ms text removed; heading counts retained.
nativeActivity.count: Undismissed issues first, otherwise running tasks, otherwise unread messages; tooltip reports all three. Compact header uses icon/count and icon-only appearance toggle.

popup.close: Outside click, Escape or explicit X using Clear SVG; tooltip/accessibility name Close activity. Closing never cancels work.
popup.ordering: Running tasks first, then recent notifications and operation history.
popup.cancel: Browser Cancel download import retained; disabled while Installing.
popup.retry: Existing browser retry and scoped operation Retry retained; Operation history defaults open for failed operations.

notifications.errors: Take priority over routine notices and remain foreground until explicitly dismissed; remain in history afterward.
notifications.read: Reading routine notices in Activity prevents repeat toast.
notifications.deduplication: Repeated notices remain distinct; unchanged errors deduplicated.
notifications.suppression: No toast while Activity is open. Confirmation/review modals suppress both popup and toasts.

history.storage: Session memory only; not durable across restart.

narrative.overview:
The user chose Plumbob from five concepts and approved its implementation. A blue navigation rail, pale blue background, white cards and green installed-state accents give the app a Sims-inspired identity. Keep words short, use recognizable icons, and let actual mod photos carry the library's personality. The charcoal dark counterpart keeps the same hierarchy with raised neutral cards, blue primary actions and restrained green state accents.

This guide describes the Linux Fastframe/egui app. `native/src/settings.rs::ThemeColors::base` and `native/src/ui.rs::base_style` define the built-in colors. Rust widgets are authoritative; dimensions use egui logical points. Fresh settings default to light. Existing saved appearance choices and custom themes remain intact.
keyCharacteristics: Blue light navigation and charcoal dark navigation with Your mods, Discover and Updates.
Photo cards and compact list rows with direct On/Off switches.
Short labels, original plumbob and compass icons, and recoverable management actions.

rules.name: readable metadata
rules.body: Use the explicit muted color for secondary text. Custom palettes retain six roles per appearance mode. Valid fills and accents remain as chosen. Adjust text, metadata and links against each actual painted background, targeting 4.5:1 contrast. Invalid hex colors prevent saving; low contrast does not replace a whole palette.

dos: Do keep navigation and management labels short and recognizable.
Do preserve real photos, readable muted text, keyboard focus and selected identity.
Do require confirmation for source attachment and reviewed management actions.
Do require user initiation for downloads and update checks.
donts: Don't invent photos, authors, provider candidates or counters.
Don't open details or a confirmation popup when a managed mod's On/Off switch is clicked.
Don't permanently delete user files or remove unmanaged files.
